Tyrannosaurus

Tyrannosaurus is a genus of Dinosauria placed in Tyrannosaurini in Phylosaur's classification. This page shows where it sits in the dinosaur family tree.

Find it in the game

Phylosaur is a daily game: you identify a hidden genus by following clues through this family tree. Genera are ranked by how well known they are, from Level I (very familiar) to Level V (rarely heard of). Tyrannosaurus is Level I.

Classifications follow the Phylosaur database, built from The Taxonomicon and reviewed against other sources. They change as research advances. Fossil details cite the papers listed on each page.
